headline: StarVLA-α reports competitive VLA results with a compact Qwen3-VL policy
summary: The Sep 16, 2026 v2 of StarVLA-α studies a deliberately simple vision-language-action baseline built from a Qwen3-VL-4B backbone and an MLP action head. Across LIBERO, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin 2.0 and RoboCasa-GR1, the authors report competitive results for benchmark-specific policies and a single model jointly trained across datasets. On RoboChallenge, the paper reports 33.6% success and 54.5 progress for StarVLA-α on the ARX5 11-task set, versus 12.7% and 27.6 for π0.5. Additional appendices report real-world out-of-distribution tasks and LIBERO-Plus perturbation results. These measurements are paper-reported; independent reproduction, several physical-trial denominators and variability estimates remain open.
